Clock in, pauses and clock out from the phone. The record Spanish law requires, as a PDF.
A link of your own. The customer picks a slot, accepts your notices and the booking lands in your diary.

planes.subtitulo: The first 14 days, everything. Then the plan that fits. The price is per workshop, not per person.
planes.anual: Pay the full year and get two months free.

incluye: 5 cars in the workshop at once
Board, timer and bookings in the diary

lista.para: For web bookings and seeing the numbers.

planes.aviso: When the trial ends, if you do not subscribe, the workshop moves to Free. Nothing is deleted.

lista.p: What do the 14 free days include?
lista.r: The whole Complete plan, no card. Create the account, set up your workshop and use it with your team. If it convinces you, subscribe from inside the app.
The workshop moves to the Free plan. Nothing is deleted, but that plan allows one person and five cars at once, so with more than that you will need to subscribe to keep adding cars.

lista.p: Does it do invoices or quotes?
lista.r: No, on purpose. That stays in your invoicing software, which is the one that has to comply with the tax office. ControlBox handles what happens inside the workshop.

lista.p: Is the working-hours record legally valid?
lista.r: It stores each person’s clock-in, pauses and clock-out every day, it can be printed or downloaded as a PDF and each worker can see their own. That is what article 34.9 of the Spanish Workers’ Statute requires.

lista.p: How do mechanics log their time?
lista.r: On the car: they press Start when they pick it up and Finish when they are done. They can pause if they switch cars. There are no job sheets to fill in.

lista.p: Does it work on the phone?
lista.r: Yes. It installs as an app on Android and iPhone from the browser, with no app store. Everyone sees their own: the mechanic their cars, the office everything.
Your workshop and nobody else. Each workshop is kept separate from the others in the database. We see how many workshops there are and which plan they are on, not their cars or their customers.

lista.p: What if I want to stop?
lista.r: You cancel from inside the app, without calling anyone. You keep access until the end of the period you have paid for.

cierre.titulo: Ready to put the workshop in order?
cierre.texto: Fourteen days with everything, no card. Then you decide.
